name: I'm good on the front lines, too!
Farzen, you can advance another step!
I knew it was going to be a tough fight!
If we can just hold out now, we've won!
So they're ready, just as I planned.
The demon's still up?! No, that's okay.
It's half-dead from the last strike!
To make it through this crisis, I'll...
...need my own skills, not just Weiss's.
Weiss would scold me if he saw this.
Farzen, you can pull back now!
You've done a great job already!
We can't have the leader fall, Rouche!
I'll take over for now, so pull back!
It's okay to play it safe, Julius!
I've failed! I should've known it...
I can't let anything happen to you!
Did I go beyond mere imitation?
I'm good on the front lines, too!
I have never felt you were a burden.
And you needn't worry at all.
I told the Hall that this might happen.
Yes, that's him. You know him, too.
He'd run straight here if he could.
My subjects hail me as a hero-king!
I will not yield before any foe!
Tighten the castle guard! Double it!
Don't let a single foe near Mariela!
I will keep you safe no matter what.
Someone must know of my power, father.
There is an army bound for us, yes?
I never wished for these visions...
They only make me a burden...
The Summoners' Hall? Your friend there?
The forces bound for our nation...
I only want to prevent more suffering...
I can see signs of upheaval to come...
I only wish this was simple unease.
I can smell it from across the Gate!
A perfect woman's scent, and more!
I always go out to steal new wives.
A bad feeling? You're my daughter and...
My nose is tingling and telling me...
...that my new wife's power is amazing!
With her power, I might end up...
She had a bad hunch about this...
Serge's off on recon at the perimeter?
I was right to trust him with Sonia.
It's not like I'm really worried...
I just have a bad feeling, is all.
I know. Taking wives from other races...
I'm sure I'm right, since it's you.
I'll shut up about it. Go wild today!
It's not an omen. And it's not like me.
Serge... Oh, he's gone already. Typical.
All I can do is trust dad and wait.
Sonia, is there something bothering you?
In Ishgria, land of the fittest...
My skills keep me alive. They're real.
Time to train for war with the dragons.
He left without checking the perimeter.
Just like Viktor, leader of the lions.
Sonia left already? That went smoothly.
It seems like a sign of clan trust.
Viktor, I haven't forgotten my debt.
Mariela?! Get back inside your room!
How can they be so strong?!
I will defend Mariela with my life!
Demon scum! You won't get past me!
Father, nobody else needs to be hurt!
My father is suffering because of me...
So if I go with you...
I won't let you harm my country further.
The dragon scum attacked with dad gone.
Was that what my feeling was about?!
Serge, thank you. You saw through it.
Yeah, dad. Beat the dragons down!
We can't let them get away with this!
I'm from the lion clan, too. I'll win this!
Leave Sonia to me. You go fight!
Argh, there's so many of them...!
I'll keep Sonia safe no matter what!
That's the only way to repay my debt!
Then I just need to buy her time!
This is terrible... Those dragon scum!
The cowards struck while I was away!
You both fought well without me.
Now fall back and leave the rest to me!
So you're here to greet me, Barion?
Argh... You came at my people like this?
So long as my people live, I will win!
I can't let myself lose to you!!
Sonia... I'm sorry it ended this way.
A dragon? Who are you people?
Ohh... Oww... That storm was awful.
Argh! And we just cleared the storm!
We didn't even want to come here!
Tsch, and the storm screwed up the ship.
Let's fix the ship and get out of here!
Where did that Falma get to?
He didn't get thrown off, right?
Whew... We finally lost the dragons.
No need to stick around where they live.
Where are we? I don't like this place...
What are those? Some race of...dragons?
Unknown foes, unknown place. Bad idea.
We're getting out of here, Grafl!
It's not like Grand Gaia at all...
Grafl's doing repairs. I've got this!
Whew... Managed to drive them off.
We'll move once he gets the ship fixed.
Who are you? Do you know where you are?!
If our chief weds a human woman...
W-Well, really, you are meant to be...
If you say you can accept it...
...then I will hold my piece. Still...
The flying ship was sighted here?
And the ship's crew was human?
That again? Enough! Lord Barion decided.
You intend to disobey our leader?
No more about that. It's over.
And if you think she's a normal human...
She isn't from this world, and yet...
I do have my own opinions on this...
...but she will be good for Lord Barion.
Barion's wife has had a child.
We're all that's left of the lion clan.
Yet he works to expand his clan...
I will kill his child, the dragon heir!
It's not innocent! It's his child!
I won't forget the pain of our losses!
For dad, and all of our clan...
I will avenge you, one way or another!
Huh?! Kill it? An innocent child?!
Fine. Your father saved my life.
So, logically, I have to serve his daughter.
Viktor... You ordered me to protect her.
I'm going to, no matter what comes next.
I hate Barion and his clan, too. But...
Don't even think it. Right now, I...
...will do what Sonia wants. That's all!
The lion demons are after my child!
And they've come so close already!
Lyonesse, I must ask a favor.
I entrust you with my...with our child.
No, if you fight here, the danger is...
That is the future I see!
I'll hold the lions off for a while.
Lyonesse, take my child to Grand Gaia!
I will try to call a trusted friend.
If you can make it to him...
Are you the ones after my child?
I won't let you near him!
I can sense deep sadness from you.
But I cannot let you pass!
I spent my life to create that barrier.
Now I know why I have these visions!
I've bought enough time. Now, I...
A vision from your powers? What was it?
...but we never imagined she'd do this!
Nonsense! I can take them myself!
Very well. I will do as you say.
I will keep the Dragon clan's heir safe.
Argh! When we ended the Lion clan...
No, I...I should follow Mariela's lead.
Move forward, don't mourn the past.
Mariela, you were Lord Barion's wife.
I won't let your death have been in vain!
They're after me! So Mariela is...
To keep Lord Barion's child safe...
...I must hide him. They come later.
This will do for now... Okay.
Now, I face them as a dragon warrior!
Why are you so focused on this child?
We may not be, but he's innocent!
Urgh... I can feel their rage!
But I won't die in vain, as a dragon!
At last. You're the one Mariela trusted.
I've finally found you. This is the end.
Now you'll feel our hatred... Our rage!
I see... You're one of their best.
Killing both will hurt him even more!
Nothing will change my resolve on this.
Serge, you search for the child.
You'll be facing me, dragon woman!
I'll find the kid once you're dead.
My dad was so kind to your people...
I'm the only one left to avenge him!
The strength to beat this dragon scum!
Killing the child would've been empty.
I knew that. Dad, Serge...I'm sorry...
Watch out! She's one of Barion's elites.
So you really will kill the child?
Alright. Then as a lion clan member...
I have no mercy for those who interfere!
Such strange power. Are you dragon clan?
Then you're just another enemy to us!
We're isolated now, and can't turn back.
Whether or not I'm lost, I can't turn back!
It's for the best I couldn't find him.
I'm sorry, Sonia... See you in hell...
Are you the Summoners who've invaded?
I can sense Lord Barion's presence!
Blue hair and eyes...? C-Could he be?!
Very well... I will take you there now.
To see your father, Lord Barion...
Lyonesse, the child you defended is here.
He looks human. To awaken his power...
I must awaken his demon blood.
This is pitiful, for Lord Barion's son.
I must awaken his power immediately...
You will come to us of your own will.
No, you will have no choice but to come!
Ugh, now it's a dragon-looking demon...
Just when I thought I'd shaken Shusui...
...I run into a demon like this.
What's up? Why are you staring at me?
If you won't fight, that's fine with me.
My father?! You know my father?!
What kind of person is he?
I always wanted to know my real dad...
...but I never tried to look into him.
Of course, I love old man Grahdens...
...but I still want to know my real dad.
Can I really just kill this demon?
And if I learn who I really am...
You... I see. So you survived...
It matters not whether you are my son...
This is Ishgria. Show me your power!
Hmph. It seems you have forgotten how...
...to use your power while among humans.
Power is everything here, and if you...
...cannot use your power, you will die.
Cast off your emotions, they weaken you!
Just as they did the Lion clan's leader!
Your eyes seem weak, but hold strength.
I see now! You have reminded me!
All in Ishgria hate, and are hated!
The weak sink beneath destiny's waves!
Use your strength, child of the dragon!
Has humanity made you a coward?!
Ignis Weiser
